quarterly_data.signal: DoD award: modification P00380 to contract FA8823-20-C-0004 with L3Harris Technologies Inc. (Colorado Springs, Colorado) for the Unified Messaging System effort, bringing the contract's total cumulative face value to $1,527,155,327 from $1,494,014,252; work in Colorado Springs and Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, expected completion October 2028; fiscal 2026 RDT&E funds of $2,419,579 obligated at award; contracting activity Space Systems Command, Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado. (DoD posted corrections on Oct. 14 and Oct. 16, 2026 about this modification's release and award date.)
